title: feat(v3face): fill-from-(1,0,0) is not equivalent to vertex3=1
science: A genuine correction of the naive reading of #6444/#6446, and a real class-level negative. Scoring all 32 F_cut maps on fill-from-(1,0,0): N_fill=4, N_v3=16, N_both=4, so 'fills from the shared-face seed' is NOT equivalent to vertex3=1.
